command: uv run --python python3.13 python scripts/run_relation_feasibility_audit.py --extractor agent --cases scripts/validation/relation_feasibility/fixtures/biomedical_relation_goldset_v2.json --output-dir reports/relation_feasibility/2026-07-02-pr2-grounding-gate-agent-strict
environment_note: Local strict-agent run on 2026-07-02. OpenAI API key was unavailable to the extractor, so all agent-mode cases used unavailable/fallback diagnostics and the verdict is RED. PR-2 treats that as expected evidence that live agent quality is still unproven while the grounding gate itself is now measurable and fail-closed for AI-authored claims.

summary.verdict_reason: 30/30 cases are invalid because agent extraction did not complete without fallback.

implementation_evidence.proposal_metadata: Document extraction proposals now include metadata.evidence_grounding with anchor_start, anchor_end, match_kind, score, subject_present, object_present, and grounded.
implementation_evidence.audit_gate: Candidate value now requires a grounded sentence plus subject and object presence in the evidence sentence.
implementation_evidence.graph_hard_floor: AI-authored relation claims that require evidence are invalid unless metadata.evidence_grounding has grounded=true, subject_present=true, and object_present=true.
implementation_evidence.create_route_behavior: AI-authored insufficient_evidence validation results return HTTP 400 instead of persisting a claim.
implementation_evidence.canonical_relation_hard_floor: POST /relations now applies the same AI grounding hard floor before creating the resolved claim or materializing a canonical relation.

adversarial_review.blocking_finding: Canonical relation promotion bypassed the PR-2 AI grounding floor because POST /relations validated ordinary evidence presence but not metadata.evidence_grounding before persistence.
adversarial_review.fix: The shared AI evidence validator now accepts both claim-create and relation-create requests, and POST /relations calls validate_ai_authored_relation_request after triple validation and before persistence.
adversarial_review.non_blocking_risk: Direct POST /relations writes still depend on AI markers because KernelRelationCreateRequest has no agent_run_id or ai_provenance field; proposal promotion sets evidence_sentence_source=artana_generated.
